name: both-reboot
purpose: Both drives boot, the workspace persists, and the root overlay resets.

name: a-alone
purpose: Drive A boots independently and accepts degraded writes.

name: rejoin-a
purpose: Drive B rejoins and the mirror retains A's degraded write.

name: b-alone
purpose: Drive B boots independently and accepts degraded writes.

name: rejoin-b
purpose: Drive A rejoins and the mirror retains B's degraded write.
